none: PAS CAM-09CB96: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy nummus of Valentinian I, AD 364-375.
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE ; D/ D N VALENTINI-ANVS P F AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Valentinian I, AD 364-375 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE. Reverse shows Victory advancing left, holding wreath and palm.Mint is possibly Aquileia, AD 364-375. Obverse legend reads D N VALENTINI-ANVS P F AVG. Obverse shows Pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...](P). Condition is very fine,…
